assumptions: Each parquet training row represents one target event; its immediately preceding source item is history[-1]. Empty-history rows are initial events and are excluded from adjacency statistics.
The item row index used by the embedding matrix and baseline code export is the item ID used in train.parquet.

Stage 3 should consume this candidate's item_sids.json as the complete SID mapping; tuple position carries the same global level permutation, and collision-extension tokens remain appended as in baseline.
Candidate artifacts must remain inside the owned tree to avoid overwriting frozen baseline outputs.
